rows.label: tlk70000076_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Among you, some are good at attacking,
some at defense, and some at healing,
right?

rows.label: tlk70000076_01_msg0002
rows.name:
An attacker's role is simple: keep
attacking the enemy and bring it down.

rows.label: tlk70000076_01_msg0003
rows.name:
That's not to say attackers
should be reckless.

rows.label: tlk70000076_01_msg0004
rows.name:
The more you attack, the more the
enemy's hostility turns toward you.

rows.label: tlk70000076_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Attack in moderation and let the
defender draw the enemy's hostility!
That's a cardinal rule of combat!

rows.label: tlk70000076_01_msg0006
rows.name:
...Well, of course there's no need
to tell you that. You managed to
best me in combat, after all.
